name: Setup Wizard tail calibrate and end stops hold only after the side button
step: Check that the tail calibrate and end stops pages do not move the tail on entry
rationale:
The tail step of the Setup Wizard holds the yaw input on its calibrate and end stops pages.
The hold was taken as soon as the page was built, so going Next into the end stops page drove
the tail to the stored limit with no button pressed. On a linkage that binds there, the servo is
forced before the pilot has done anything on that page.

The harness drives the real setup_wizard_tail.lua from its Start page to the calibrate and end
stops pages, with the UI and art modules replaced by recording stubs and the real raw units, and
pins: nothing is held on entry, and the side button starts the hold.

--self-test runs the same checks on a copy that takes the hold on entry (the old behaviour) and
requires it to go red.
